_doc: Descriptions VISUELLES (en anglais, pour le générateur d'images). Dans les lignes '@' des histoires, {nom} est remplacé par la description ; pour un héros, {nom} ajoute le costume de l'univers et {nom-} donne le héros sans costume.

heros.filou: Filou, a small red fox cub with bright orange fur, a white belly, a white tail tip and a little green scarf
heros.nestor: Nestor, a big round brown bear cub with a cream muzzle and a little blue scarf
heros.rosie: Rosie, a small white rabbit with long ears, pink inside, and a little red scarf
heros.plume: Plume, a small round beige owl with big round dark eyes and a little yellow scarf

costumes.pirates: wearing a striped sailor shirt and a red pirate bandana
costumes.espace: wearing a white astronaut suit with a round glass helmet
costumes.ocean: wearing a round glass diving helmet
costumes.noel: wearing a red woolly hat with a white pompom
costumes.ski: wearing a woolly hat and a warm winter jacket

decors.ski: a snowy mountain ski resort with fir trees, a wooden chalet and a chairlift under a blue sky
decors.mer: a sunny beach with dunes, a striped parasol, sandcastles and gentle waves

style: Children's picture book illustration, flat 2D vector art in the Franco-Belgian 'ligne claire' tradition and 1950s storybooks: clean thin dark outlines, flat soft pastel colours, simple rounded shapes, no gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Square composition, characters centred and fully visible.
fin: Cute expressive animal characters, warm and gentle mood, no humans, no text, no letters, no speech bubbles, no watermark.
